source_basis: general knowledge and independent visual reasoning

concepts.name: 암석 단층 촬영에서 열린 우주적 단면
concepts.whole_scene: A removed meteorite core in a tomographic laboratory has a freshly cut face whose interior continues into a vast lightless built space. The exact small cut face and the enormous distance visible through it contradict one another; a researcher has stopped comparing a matching slice.
concepts.viewer_experience: Material evidence that measurement has opened onto a scale the room cannot contain.
concepts.qualitative_difference: Scale and depth contradiction in a solid geological object.

concepts.name: 심해 배양 시료가 측정격자보다 깊어지는 순간
concepts.whole_scene: A chilled quartz observation cell holds a pale nonhuman tissue sheet stretched through a calibrated lattice. The near sheet is thin and measurable while the same continuous tissue recedes as a cavernous folded interior behind the lattice. A researcher has withdrawn the sampling probe but cannot close the observation shutter.
concepts.viewer_experience: A controlled biological sample becomes an environment, making the act of measurement look inadequate.
concepts.qualitative_difference: Organism/environment ambiguity and continuity through a scientific frame.

concepts.name: 전파 측정 장치에 응결된 비인간적 청취 구조
concepts.whole_scene: A radio-spectroscopy bench at dawn has acquired a wet black mineral film. The film grows a coherent ring of cavities directed toward the receiver, and the receiver housing is being drawn inward around its own aperture. A researcher watches the apparatus change from a measuring tool into something that attends back.
concepts.viewer_experience: Scientific observation encounters nonhuman reciprocal attention without a familiar monster body.
concepts.qualitative_difference: Agency and reversed observation communicated through a changing instrument.

reference_scope: face and hair appearance guidance only; no identity, clothing, body, pose or composition preservation
